added_failures_note: Unmeasured: source manifest has neither baseline_suite nor after_suite; source document explicitly declares its measurement-only suite unarmed. No measured zero is inferred from absent logs.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Changing the local residual denominator or norm without changing fixed_point._relative_residual causes the cross-check to fail; independent implementation, shared inputs.
Changing assembly of only one component or defect can fail, but changing tare itself cannot because it cancels from both sides; no independent tare validation.
Disabling JAX float64 fails the configuration assertions.
A retained field containing nonfinite values fails the finite-state assertion; it does not prove revision provenance.
A captured total force inconsistent with the separately differentiated plasma and external fields fails force closure; this cannot detect a common sign or normalization mistake in both computations.
A wall maximum with a seed whose length does not equal grid nodes plus wall points fails the layout assertion.
Fewer or more than four captured row receipts fail row-count assertions; these do not independently require each specific row identity.
A nonconverged MAST solve or direct terminal map residual at least 1e-8 fails the known-root control.

Returning the seed instead of the translated saddle fails the independent analytic endpoint; admitting a convex field fails not-connected; replacing missing landmarks by zero fails the literal null expectation; the script is in the run directory rather than the committed regression suite.

reuse.reason: the reuse shortfall is the duplicated figure-save checks in a one-off measurement renderer (finding 1); no product code is duplicated

figure_review.result: All four readable with no clipped or overlapping labels; population contours and nulls visible. ImageMagick emitted scratch-path warnings but produced viewable 1400px images.

filing_blocker: Review contract requires an integer failure delta derived from source suite-arm logs that do not exist; coordinator must resolve the unarmed-suite exception or supply completed source arms.

0.reason: measurement-only script: the closure assertion is kept as bookkeeping, and the research document does not claim it protects against tare regression

1.reason: one-off diagnostic renderer in a measurement script, with no product surface; the duplicated save checks are not imported anywhere and are retired with the script

findings.text: non-blocking: The closure assertion is algebraic rather than an independent tare check: the same tare is subtracted from plasma and added to the reference remainder, so replacing it with an incorrect or zero tare leaves the assertion true while changing the contributor ranking; retain this as a bookkeeping check and do not count it as protection against tare regression.

non-blocking: The new save function duplicates canvas-bound and text-overlap validation owned by benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:3782, rather than extending or wrapping it; its extra panel exclusion and SVG sizing leave two implementations of the same checks to maintain, although this does not invalidate the inspected figures or numerical receipts.

justifications.reuse: scripts/diiid_map_fidelity/measure.py reuses profile construction, current adapters, the registered request and map operators, but render.py:26 duplicates the existing checked-save capability in benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:3782 instead of extending or wrapping that owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: All twelve paths in the base-to-head diff lie in the three grants in the source manifest, and scripts/diiid_map_fidelity/measure.py imports rather than modifies nova product code.
